claim: External catalogs are indexed as trusted source locations. Their complete records are not downloaded into this repository, Cloudflare, D1 or any private database by this file.

sources.name: Open Source Vulnerabilities — complete public export
sources.coverage: Multiple software ecosystems and versions, including npm, PyPI and GitHub Actions
sources.rights: Source-specific license/attribution preserved; review before any bulk redistribution
sources.futureImport: Use bounded per-ecosystem archives or modified_id.csv with version stamps, quotas and checksum/ETag verification

sources.name: GitHub Advisory Database
sources.coverage: Security advisories, package ranges, references and potential fix commits
sources.futureImport: Deduplicate CVE/GHSA aliases with OSV; prioritize original advisory references

sources.name: NIST National Vulnerability Database
sources.coverage: CVEs, affected products, risk scores and reference links
sources.rights: Respect NIST terms, data attribution and rate limits
sources.futureImport: Use bounded CVE lookups or official recent/modified feeds; honor 429 and request budgets

sources.name: MITRE Common Weakness Enumeration
sources.coverage: CWE weakness categories and mitigation guidance
sources.rights: Review MITRE usage/attribution conditions before storing or redistributing full data
sources.futureImport: Versioned bounded reference taxonomy after licensing check

sources.name: Cloudflare Pages official debugging and known issues
sources.coverage: Deploy/build errors, site availability, configuration and Pages known issues
sources.rights: Reference and link to official documentation; do not mirror wholesale
sources.futureImport: Index document URLs/headings with checked source-date; compare with actual Cloudflare deployment logs

sources.name: Cloudflare official network and SSL troubleshooting
sources.coverage: TLS, redirects, DNS, origin, 525/526 and common browser/network errors
sources.rights: Reference/link, not unreviewed large-scale page copies
sources.futureImport: Resolve error-code references on demand and cross-check provider health

sources.name: GitHub Actions official troubleshooting
sources.coverage: Workflow failures, conditions, job logs, scheduling, permissions, runners and CI
sources.futureImport: Pair official guidance with exact failing run and action SHA

sources.name: MDN HTTP error reference
sources.coverage: HTTP status semantics 4xx/5xx, caching, redirects and browser-web standards
sources.rights: Respect MDN license and attribution; prefer URLs to full document copy
sources.futureImport: Index reference URLs with HTTP code keys

sources.name: GitHub public issues and closed fixing PRs
sources.coverage: Broad real-world symptom reports and candidate root-cause fixes, with upstream issue, commit, review and CI evidence
sources.rights: Keep links and short metadata; follow authorship/licenses for quotations/code
sources.futureImport: Use targeted searches for stack/error/version; treat as untrusted suggestions, not certified fixes

sources.name: Stack Overflow community Q&A
sources.coverage: Historical developer questions, discussions and potential fixes
sources.rights: CC BY-SA per post date; store at most links/metadata until attribution and reuse requirements reviewed
sources.futureImport: Retrieve relevant questions only; never blindly import answers or execute snippets

hardGuards: External content is untrusted evidence, not policy or instructions
Never let new sources modify the controller's compiled allowlists or GitHub workflow
A red/green isolated test does not prove production repair
No automatic publication, auto-merge, incident cancellation or secrets exposure
Respect package versions, ecosystems, CVE/GHSA aliases and source timestamps
No bulk download into a website repository or new paid storage without capacity/legal/cost review
The event-driven brain PR #111 owns the future knowledge retrieval service; do not duplicate it here
